meta.data: results/ngsim_lambda_cal_20261019/out/p_S.npz: the 10 Hz frames of the 2,954 Val+Test calibration vehicles (natural NGSIM traffic, final-set vehicles included) with a STDAN probability (>= 30 frames of history) whose +-28-frame label window lies inside the track: 2378400 frames of 2954 vehicles, label LK / LLC / RLC 2314949 / 46933 / 16518
meta.label: STDAN's own intention label (predictor/stdan_3int_signed_tcross_velint/preprocessing/preprocess_3int_signed_tcross.py, label_vehicle_rows): a frame within +-28 frames (2.8 s) of a Lane_ID transition takes that transition's direction (LLC to a lower Lane_ID, RLC to a higher one), the nearest transition winning (a tie to the earlier one); LK otherwise. On US-101 (recordings 1-3) Lane_IDs >= 6 are one lane
meta.model: bias-corrected temperature scaling (Alexandari et al., ICML 2020; temperature scaling of Guo et al., ICML 2017, with one bias per class): q = softmax(log p / T + b), b = (0, b_left, b_right), p the predictor's (LK, LLC, RLC) clipped at 1e-7 and renormalised; fitted by the mean 3-class log loss (L-BFGS-B, analytic gradient, start T 1, b 0) on every frame of the training recordings
meta.sides: no lane mask: a side without a lane keeps its fitted probability, at run time and in the evaluation (the label keeps a lane change's direction for 2.8 s after the crossing, into an edge lane too; an adjacent vehicle's side without a lane is never its cut-in side)
meta.folds: folds[k] is fitted without NGSIM recording k (1-3 US-101, 4-6 I-80); the replay applies folds[ds] to an episode of recording ds (cross-fitting); all = every recording
meta.predictor: IAIMM-KF with the paper's ISA-MPC setting (ISAMPC_IAIMM_CFG), R_NGSIM, the lane markings
